title: Insurance Claim (Third-Party Billing): Member Cost Share Netted From a Retained Payment
content:
**Cash posting reference.** On an Insurance Claim (Third-Party Billing) whose observation or emergency post-payment denial is refunded, the member's cost share is taken from the retained value, never below 0.00, to give the retained payment. The cost share is read from the patient-responsibility lines released from the claim to the patient:

| Patient-responsibility lines released from the claim | Member's cost share |
|---|---|
| copay lines (PR-3) | the total of those copay lines |
| no copay line, but deductible or coinsurance lines (PR-1, PR-2) | the total of those lines |
| none of these | 0.00 |

**Hypothetical cases (retained value 300.00)**
- Copay lines of 80.00 and a coinsurance line of 40.00: cost share 80.00; retained payment 220.00.
- Deductible line 60.00 and coinsurance line 30.00, no copay: cost share 90.00; retained payment 210.00.
- Copay lines of 400.00: retained payment 0.00 (never below 0.00).
